2.6.4.standard: About 6 h a window, 8 a wounding, 12 a robbery, 22 a killing, then released under investigation or charged and remanded (not bail); under 2 real minutes; never twice for one deed (ER-POL-03). Inside PACE limits (24 h, 36 serious); 73% of 1984-87 detainees held under 6 h; 542 held over 24 h in 1990.
2.6.4.standard_source: CLOUD-FIGURES-2026-11-21.md B2: Hansard 8 Jul 1987; Home Office bulletin 1991 via Statewatch; Bottomley 1991 via Kemp and others

2.7.6.standard: About a third of retail (0.33), from 0.2 for jewellery to 0.4 for a video recorder; less for each further piece the same week; buyers differ in what they take (second-hand shop radios and video recorders, scrap yard car parts, a man at the back of the caff jewellery); each is also a listener. 8.3.1.standard: Resolution incl. 21:9 at 3440x1440; windowed, borderless, full screen; V-sync; frame cap 30/60/120/none; a quality preset with per-option overrides; resolution scale; an upscaler where the engine has one; motion blur off by default; a benchmark or settings preview; HDR and field of view judged with Unreal (field of view his point AX-03)

GD-04.standard_source: CLOUD-FIGURES-2026-11-21.md C4: KCD2 one ending, 8 epilogue decisions and 3 later paths (Gamepressure, PC Gamer 2025); RDR2 2 endings, 4 with honour (rdr2.org 2023, SegmentNext 2024); LEDGER's eight differences in five hours asks more than either

8.2.1.standard: (1) Nothing leaves the PC without a yes, and nothing is read or sent before it; (2) the question says what is sent, why, to whom and how long it is kept; No and Never as easy as Yes and Always; withdrawable in Settings; (3) the report contains no typed talk, no save unless ticked, no serial, machine id, user name or named path; (4) an unsent local report is deleted after 30 days; (5) the game never crashes while writing its own report (a forced crash test).
8.2.1.standard_source: PRIVACY-CHECK-2026-11-21.md: ICO storage and access guidance (13 May, 29 Apr 2026), ICO blog 11 Sep 2025; consent route as fault reports are not strictly necessary
8.2.1.basis: pass or fail on the ICO's published guidance (run 3)

10.11.standard: (1) The AI notice, its own screen before the first typed line, says replies are made by a named AI service over the internet, what is sent, why and for how long, and offers offline play as an equal choice; readable again from pause; (2) nothing typed is sent before it is answered; (3) offline mode plays the whole first hour; (4) no copy of typed text kept beyond the story's memory unless reported; (5) the service's retention and the deletion route are as stated.
10.11.standard_source: PRIVACY-CHECK-2026-11-21.md: ICO guidance; EU AI Act Article 50(1), in force 2 Aug 2026 (Commission FAQ 24 Jul 2026)
10.11.basis: pass or fail on the ICO's guidance and Article 50 (run 3)
